I was told nothing would be done as it was of no concern and was classed as cosmetic. Skip forward about 11 years and during a routine smear test the nurse asked about my lump. I explained what I had previously been told and she put forward a referral for minor surgery with Dr Sykes. Saw Dr Sykes and he agreed to remove lump.
